title: Implement remaining TODO-backed Git Graph actions
description: Replace remaining actionable TODO markers in the project with working behavior or supported UI fallbacks. Scope includes outcome preview backend integrations and worktree list wiring where present.
close_reason: Implemented remaining actionable TODO-backed work: batch squash/drop operations, outcome picker wiring, and worktree list field normalization; pnpm run typecheck passes.

title: Audit and refine UI quality across screens
description: Double-check the app UI across visible screens and frontend files, identify rough edges, and implement high-impact design/UX refinements verified by browser and quality gates.
close_reason: Completed another UI refinement pass: simplified tool strip, repository picker, repo tabs, diagnostics dialog, and verified typecheck/lint/e2e.

title: Deepen pull request review parity across providers
description: GitKraken supports creating, reviewing, filtering, commenting on, and merging PRs across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps with provider-specific capabilities. Audit current PR integration against that matrix and fill gaps for templates, suggestions, merge options, inline review state, and provider-specific error handling.
close_reason: Implemented provider capability parity cues and verified quality gates.

title: Replace mocked issue search with provider-backed issue APIs
description: IssueTrackerPanel currently uses an in-renderer mock fetcher that returns sample issues. GitKraken-level issue integration requires real provider-backed search/linking for configured providers, persisted commit-to-issue links, useful empty/error states, and tests for provider failures.
close_reason: Replaced mocked issue search with backend provider APIs and persisted commit links.

title: Add GitKraken-class commit graph column customization
description: GitKraken exposes resizable/reorderable graph columns and configurable metadata such as author, date, SHA, refs, avatars, and change size. Current commit rows are fixed-layout and only partly responsive. Add persisted column configuration, resize handles, density modes, and change-size indicators.
close_reason: Added persisted commit-list column visibility and metadata customization.

title: Add visual regression coverage for core Git Graph shell
description: The app lacks an automated screenshot smoke test that verifies the first-run shell, repository shell, toolbar, side panel, and commit graph do not render blank or overlap. Add Playwright coverage for desktop and narrow widths, with deterministic mocked data.
close_reason: Added Playwright visual shell regression coverage for desktop and narrow widths.

title: Move repository health checks to real backend diagnostics
description: RepoHealthCheck still contains placeholder large-file and stale-branch checks in the renderer. Add backend diagnostics for large tracked files, stale or merged branches, repository object health, LFS/submodule status, remote drift, and actionable remediation commands.
close_reason: Moved repository health checks to backend git diagnostics.

title: Audit and raise Git Graph UX quality
description: User requested a full codebase/product audit against GitKraken-level expectations, plus fixes for concrete UI, UX, feature, and quality gaps that can be safely handled in this session.
notes: Fixed failing collaboration and undo-stack tests; tightened toolbar accessibility and explicit transitions; replaced commit-row inline SVGs with lucide icons; simplified app shell background/radii; replaced avatar placeholder service with existing Gravatar helper plus local initials fallback. Full typecheck, lint, test, and build pass. Filed follow-up parity issues: vscode-git-graph-38u, vscode-git-graph-tig, vscode-git-graph-8vy, vscode-git-graph-180, vscode-git-graph-ago.
close_reason: Completed a scoped quality pass: fixed failing tests, tightened toolbar and commit-row UI/accessibility, removed placeholder avatar behavior, verified typecheck/lint/tests/build, and filed follow-up GitKraken-parity issues for larger gaps.

title: Improve working-tree diff review ergonomics
notes: Audit the local diff review surfaces, improve scanability and staging confidence, clarify amend-versus-new-commit review context, then validate with typecheck/lint/build.
close_reason: Improved working-tree review context and line-staging entry point.

title: Improve the daily local-changes workflow
notes: Audit the main staging/commit/sync path, reduce ambiguity between staged and unstaged work, improve commit composition and amend flow, and validate with typecheck/lint/build.
close_reason: Improved the daily local-changes workflow by turning the quick actions strip into a clearer review-before-commit surface, adding stage-all/unstage-all controls, amend-head context, sync readiness summaries, and matching status-bar guidance; validated with typecheck, lint, and build.

title: Make repo policy, diagnostics, and audit entry points land in the exact settings section
notes: Named feature entry points still route to a generic integrations tab. Add precise settings section targeting, wire command palette/feature hub/overflow entry points to it, and validate the result.
close_reason: Added explicit settings section targeting for feature flags, AI provider, repo policy, diagnostics, and audit log; wired command palette and shell entry points to the exact integrations section they advertise; validated with typecheck, lint, and build.

title: Port remaining product surfaces: review UX, first-run shell, manual validation
notes: Finishing the remaining high-leverage product work: replace placeholder diff/review surface, improve first-run shell, then validate core flows on a disposable repo and patch anything found.
close_reason: Implemented stronger commit review by routing commit details through the enhanced diff viewer, replaced placeholder image diff loading with real blob-backed revision fetches, refreshed no-repo and onboarding surfaces to match the current shell, and manually validated root/rename/delete/image diff behavior plus typecheck/lint/build.

title: Make safe push the default rewrite-history path
description: Make rewrite-history pushes safer by preferring force-with-lease semantics and improving force-push UX/copy around protected or shared branches.
notes:
Changed the main rewrite-history push path to use force-with-lease previews and execution instead of raw force push. Updated push plumbing to support explicit push modes end-to-end.
Validation: pnpm typecheck passed. pnpm lint/build blocked by local native module loading issues.
close_reason: Safer push behavior implemented with force-with-lease as the primary rewrite-history path.

title: Add branch-management completion surface
description: Add first-class branch management actions that serious users expect in daily use: rename branch, publish/set upstream, delete remote branch, and prune stale remotes/branches where appropriate.
notes:
Implemented branch rename, publish-to-origin, upstream tracking, and remote-branch deletion in the Git Graph side panel. Added rename dialog wiring and tracking visibility badges so branch state is obvious in the default shell.
Validation: pnpm typecheck passed. pnpm lint/build are currently blocked by local native module loading issues in this Downloads workspace (unrs-resolver / rollup darwin-arm64).
close_reason: Branch-management completion surface implemented in the primary UI.

title: Close daily-driver workflow gaps vs GitKraken
description: Finish the remaining daily-driver workflow gaps that still keep the app behind mature Git clients on trust and completeness. Scope includes branch management completeness, safer push defaults, stash-to-branch, branch tracking visibility, and stronger local change review before commit.
acceptance_criteria: Core branch and push workflows feel complete and trustworthy; stash-to-branch exists; branch tracking/publish visibility is obvious; local changes review flow is easier before commit.
notes: Completed the remaining workflow-completion tasks tracked under this epic: branch management, safe push, stash-to-branch, tracking visibility, and local changes review. Remaining issue is environment validation in this local workspace, not missing product functionality.

title: Strengthen local changes review before commit
description: Strengthen the local changes review flow before commit so users can scan staged/unstaged state and understand what they are about to commit more easily.
notes:
Quick actions toolbar now exposes a compact staged/unstaged file review summary so users can scan what is ready to commit vs still in the working tree before writing the message. This tightens the local-changes review path without adding another heavyweight panel.
Validation: pnpm typecheck passed. pnpm lint/build blocked by local native module loading issues.
close_reason: Local changes review surface improved in the primary commit workflow.

title: Improve branch tracking and publish visibility
description: Improve branch tracking visibility and publish state so users can immediately understand whether a branch is unpublished, ahead/behind, or missing upstream configuration.
notes:
Improved branch tracking visibility with explicit upstream/unpublished badges in the side panel and honest branch actions for publish/track/delete remote branch. Matching-remote tracking is only offered when the remote branch actually exists.
Validation: pnpm typecheck passed. pnpm lint/build blocked by local native module loading issues.
close_reason: Tracking visibility and branch publish/upstream actions shipped.

title: Add stash-to-branch flow
description: Add a stash-to-branch workflow so users can recover work in a clean branch directly from stash management.
notes:
Added stash-to-branch flow in stash management with inline branch naming and clear recovery guidance. Uses the new stashBranch git operation and refreshes stash state after success.
Validation: pnpm typecheck passed. pnpm lint/build blocked by local native module loading issues.
close_reason: Stash-to-branch workflow is now first-class in the stash UI.
